identity.title: Demystifying Cost-Efficiency in LLM Serving over Heterogeneous GPUs
identity.version: PMLR v267, ICML 2025 proceedings; 19-page PDF including A–M

summary: Core scheduling formulation is not a MILP as printed and its fixed-T description is inconsistent; empirical implementation consequences remain unverified. Table 6 does not reproduce the quoted profiling-error range.
limitations: No assigned-version author source snapshot available
Separate OpenReview supplements inaccessible in acquisition record
Raw traces, unrounded profile data and solver models unavailable; later-version equivalence/errata not established

problems.title: The published scheduling model is not the claimed MILP
problems.source_claim: Section 4.3 calls equations (1)–(7) a MILP, with continuous makespan T, integer copy count y_c>=0 and load sum x_cw f_w/(y_c h_cw)<=T; Appendix E extends it and Appendix F prints sum x_cw/h_cw<=T_hat.
assumptions: price budget and GPU availability constraints
problems.suspect_step: Division by y_c; multiplying yields y_c*T, not a linear expression; y_c=0 causes 0/0; displayed Appendix F test drops f/y.

complete_check.analytic: For y_c>0 the load bound is sum(f/h)x<=y_cT; both right-side factors vary. For y_c=0 activation forces x=0, leaving the printed ratio undefined.

problems.result: Displayed model not a MILP. Literal shortened feasibility expression is invalid; this does not identify the actually executed solver.
counterevidence: Appendix F also invokes all §4.3 constraints; retaining original Eq3 rejects the counterexample and treats the shortened expression as redundant/misprinted.
An implementation could use a valid linearization, replica expansion or fixed-T oracle; unavailable code prevents deciding.
Empirical GPU benchmarking observations do not rely on every printed optimization equation being correct.
problems.core_dependency: Central advertised scheduler, multi-model extension, and Figure9 direct-MILP vs binary-search specification.
problems.impact: Invalid core mathematical formulation supports Major; no assertion of whole-paper collapse or measured benchmark loss.

correction.statement: For fixed T_hat use sum(f/h)x<=T_hat*y. For direct minimization enumerate bounded potential replicas with binary activation z and continuous per-replica assignment u, assignment sums1, u<=z, per-replica load<=T, and linear resource/budget constraints.
correction.verification: Analytic equivalence proved in report for the stated divisible-load model: split aggregate x equally among y active replicas; aggregate replica assignments in the reverse direction.
correction.scope: Mathematical model only, not runtime or actual published implementation

focused_check.method: Relevant frozen source passages/static source, existing actual check output and independent analytic integration; no author-code execution.
focused_check.conclusion: Variable replica count times variable makespan is bilinear, and the printed inactive quotient is undefined. The shortened feasibility expression admits the stated 100-versus-1 fixture; retaining all original constraints rejects it, as the report acknowledges. Fixed-threshold and replica-expanded repairs restore only their stated formulations. Major is supported by the central derivation defect, without a solver-failure claim.

assumptions: Compute from displayed two-decimal throughput values
Relative error denominator is measured value, with estimated denominator also checked
problems.result: The published values support neither common calculation of a4–7%range.
counterevidence: Raw measurements and rounding convention could differ
No incorrect optimizer selection demonstrated; highest table row ranks agree
problems.core_dependency: Local profiling validation supports the scheduler, but no material end-to-end harm proved.

correction.statement: State metric and unrounded measurements or report displayed-value measured-relative range4.76–9.52%.
correction.verification: Exact rational arithmetic on published rounded numbers

focused_check.method: Relevant frozen source passages/static source, existing actual check output and independent analytic integration; no author-code execution.
focused_check.conclusion: All seven displayed Table 6 errors were checked, including 9.5238% for L40 (2,4), and the alternative denominator still gives 8.6957%. Unrounded data or another metric could explain a different range but is not supplied. The local numerical discrepancy remains Minor.

focused_scope_check.result: The positive formulation/replica-equivalence checks and limited table arithmetic are supported within their stated assumptions. Missing assigned-version implementation, raw experiments and undigitized figure values remain explicit; no global correctness certification is added.
